entities.name: Oscar Hernández
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Oscar Eduardo Hernández Rios is a Venezuelan professional baseball catcher for the Hagerstown Flying Boxcars of the Atlantic League of Professional Baseball. He has previously played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Arizona Diamondbacks and Kansas City Royals. Listed at 6 feet 1 inch (1.85 m) and 230 pounds (100 kg), he throws and bats right-handed.
